name: @pipeworx/mcp-crossref

tools.name: search_works
tools.description: Search academic papers, books, and datasets via Crossref. For "search works titled X" / finding a SPECIFIC paper by its title, pass `title` (title-scoped — ranks the exact paper first). Beyond keyword search you can SORT by citation count or publication date and FILTER by date range, work type, author, and JOURNAL (`journal` = a journal name like "Progress in Materials Science" or an ISSN; results are restricted to that journal only) — e.g. "most-cited papers on transformers" (sort=citations), "papers on LLMs since 2024" (from_date=2024-01-01), "recent journal articles by an author". Returns titles, authors, journal, DOIs, citation counts, and dates.

query.description: Keyword query over all fields (e.g. "climate change machine learning"). Optional if "title", "author" or "journal" is given.

title.description: Title-scoped search — use when looking for a specific paper by its (partial or full) title, e.g. "Remus High Availability Asynchronous Virtual Machine Replication".

sort.description: Result ordering: "relevance" (default), "citations" (most-cited first), or "published" (newest first; note Crossref has some records with erroneous future dates).

from_date.description: Only works published on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY).

until_date.description: Only works published on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY).

journal.description: Restrict results to ONE journal: its name (e.g. "Progress in Materials Science", resolved to its ISSNs) or an ISSN (e.g. "0079-6425"). Returns only that journal's works, never other journals' papers.

type.description: Restrict to a Crossref work type, e.g. "journal-article", "book", "proceedings-article", "dataset", "posted-content" (preprints).

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-100, default 10)

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: Get full metadata for a publication by DOI (e.g., "10.1038/nature12373"). Returns title, authors, abstract, journal, publisher, citations, and subjects.

tools.name: get_journal
tools.description: Get the 5 most recent works from a journal by ISSN (e.g., "2041-1723"). Returns titles, authors, DOIs, and publication dates.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-crossref forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the crossref pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
